title: About us | 3Def Creative
description: 3Def Creative is a product-only animation studio in Turkey. Why we focus on products, what we make, and how we work with brands and agencies.
heading: We make products look as good as they deserve to.

story.heading: Our story
paragraphs: [TODO: owner to rewrite this story in their own words]I started 3Def Creative because I love advertising, and because I've seen how much a product changes when it moves well.
A good product film makes the value obvious in a few seconds: what it's made of, how it works, why it's worth the price. That only happens when the motion is right.
So we do one thing: product animation. No VFX, no characters, no side services. Just products, made to look their best.

focus.heading: Why only products
paragraphs: Doing one kind of work every day makes us better at it. We spend our time on what makes a product shot convincing: how brushed metal, frosted glass or knit fabric catch light, how much weight a product should have when it turns, and how long a reveal should hold before the cut.
We don't do VFX, character animation or creature work, and we don't take it on as a side service.

items.title: Hero visuals
items.text: Stills and short seamless loops of a single product, lit and framed to show its materials and details.
items.use: Product pages, marketplace listings, paid ads, launch assets

items.title: Short product spots
items.text: 8 to 20 second animations built on a clear shot list, with set revision rounds and exports sized for each platform.
items.use: Instagram and Reels, TikTok, paid social

items.title: Launch films
items.text: Longer, multi-scene films for a launch or campaign. We scope the length, shots and schedule with you from your brief.
items.use: Launches, campaign films, website headers, events

items.title: A clear brief
items.text: Before we model anything, we agree on the product, the goal and where the work will run.

items.title: A clear timeline
items.text: You get a schedule with review dates at the start of the project.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: One person handles your project from brief to delivery, so nothing gets lost between messages.

items.title: Set revision rounds
items.text: [TODO: confirm revision policy]Revision rounds are agreed in the quote, with checkpoints at concept and at first animation, so changes happen early.

clients.heading: Who we work with
paragraphs: Brands that need product visuals for a launch, a store or a campaign, and agencies that need a production partner for the 3D part of a job.
We focus on four verticals: gaming and tech peripherals, beauty, wellness and fashion.

location.heading: Where we are
location.text: We're based in {city}, Turkey, and work with clients in other time zones over email and video calls. Reviews happen on shared links, so distance doesn't slow a project down.

cta.text: Tell us what it is and where it will run.
